card.name: The letters 'all' inside names and terms
card.fires_on: The letters 'all' (or 'ALL') when they are part of a larger name or term, such as Goodall, NEP-ALL, INO-VATE ALL, or a broken-up 'allergic'.

modes.label: Goodall and other names
modes.description: 'all' ends a proper name such as Goodall or Amaral.
modes.example: Jane Good<<all>> Research Center at the University of Southern California

modes.label: ALL in trial and report names
modes.description: Capital 'ALL' sits inside a trial or report label.
modes.example: In adult patients in the INO-VATE<< ALL>> trial, thrombocytopenia

modes.label: Split 'allergic'
modes.description: 'all' appears as a broken piece of 'allergic' after 'sensitive' or 'Hypersensitivity'.

card.writes: It favors word pieces that continue a word, such as 'uded' and 'uding', and it suppresses size words like 'larger'.
card.plain: It fires when 'all' is tucked inside a name or a longer word, not when it means 'every'.
